cues: In sixteen seventy eight, Christiaan Huygens gave a rule for moving a wavefront forward.
First, every point on a wavefront acts as a fresh source of secondary wavelets, which spread forward at the speed of the wave in that medium.
Second, the new wavefront, a time t later, is the surface that touches all those wavelets: their forward envelope.
text: In sixteen seventy eight, Christiaan Huygens gave a rule for moving a wavefront forward. It has two parts. First, every point on a wavefront acts as a fresh source of secondary wavelets, which spread forward at the speed of the wave in that medium. Second, the new wavefront, a time t later, is the surface that touches all those wavelets: their forward envelope.
